class LosslessSourceSink:
    def __init__(self, output, name, *, popen=subprocess.Popen):
        if name not in CAMERAS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown turn source camera")
        path = Path(output) / (name + ".mkv")
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Retain prior turn camera source")
        width, height = CAMERAS[name][2]

                              "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                              "-video_size", f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", "20",
                              "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", str(path)],
                             stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
        self.closed = False

    def write(self, image):
        if self.closed or len(image.raw_data) != self.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")
        self.process.stdin.write(image.raw_data)

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            self.process.stdin.close()

    def __init__(self, world, carla_module, ego, sinks, *, overview_height_delta_m=0):

        if overview_height_delta_m not in (0, 2):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported overview camera height change")

        self.frames = {name: set() for name in CAMERAS}
        self.condition = Condition()
        self.errors = []
        self.sensors = []
        self.closed = False
        try:
            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():
                if name == 'overview':
                    loc = (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + overview_height_delta_m)
                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", size[0]), ("image_size_y", size[1]),
                                   ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0.05)):

                    carla_module.Location(*loc), carla_module.Rotation(*rot))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)

                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:

            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")

    pose = ego.get_transform()

    speed = velocity.x * cos(yaw) + velocity.y * sin(yaw)
    gap = speed_mps - speed
    return {'steer': max(-.75, min(.75, 1.2 * error)),

            'brake': max(0, min(.7, -.27 * gap))}

class LosslessSourceSink:
    def __init__(self, output, name, *, popen=subprocess.Popen):
        if name not in CAMERAS:

                              "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", str(path)],
                             stdin=subprocess.PIPE)

        if self.closed or len(image.raw_data) != self.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")
        self.process.stdin.write(image.raw_data)

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            self.process.stdin.close()
            if self.process.wait() != 0:

    def __init__(self, world, carla_module, ego, sinks, *, overview_height_delta_m=0):

        if overview_height_delta_m not in (0, 2):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported overview camera height change")

        self.frames = {name: set() for name in CAMERAS}
        self.condition = Condition()
        self.errors = []
        self.sensors = []
        self.closed = False
        try:
            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():
                if name == 'overview':
                    loc = (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + overview_height_delta_m)
                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", size[0]), ("image_size_y", size[1]),
                                   ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0.05)):
                    blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
                transform = carla_module.Transform(
                    carla_module.Location(*loc), carla_module.Rotation(*rot))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                sensor.listen(lambda image, source=name: self._receive(source, image))
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def _receive(self, name, image):
        with self.condition:
            if self.closed:
                return
            try:
                if image.frame in self.frames[name]:
                    raise ValueError("Duplicate original turn camera frame")
                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:
                    raise ValueError("Original turn camera dimensions changed")
                self.sinks[name].write(image)
                self.frames[name].add(image.frame)
            except BaseException as error:
                self.errors.append(error)
            finally:
                self.condition.notify_all()

    def wait_for_frame(self, frame, *, timeout_s=10):
        deadline = monotonic() + timeout_s
        with self.condition:
            while True:
                if self.errors:
                    raise ValueError("Turn source camera callback failed") from self.errors[0]
                if all(frame in observed for observed in self.frames.values()):
                    return
                remaining = deadline - monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Missing original turn source camera frame")
                self.condition.wait(remaining)

    def verify(self, frames):
        expected = set(frames)
        if not expected or any(observed != expected for observed in self.frames.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:

    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):

    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]

    if length <= 0:

    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))

    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.

        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")

        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from threading import Condition
from time import monotonic


CAMERAS = {
    "overview": ((-8, 0, 8), (-12, 0, 0), (1920, 1080), 95),
    "approach": ((1.2, 0, 2), (0, 0, 0), (1280, 720), 90),

    "driver_reference": ((0.6, -0.35, 1.6), (0, 0, 0), (1280, 720), 85),

class LosslessSourceSink:
    def __init__(self, output, name, *, popen=subprocess.Popen):
        if name not in CAMERAS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown turn source camera")
        path = Path(output) / (name + ".mkv")
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Retain prior turn camera source")
        width, height = CAMERAS[name][2]
        self.frame_bytes = width * height * 4
        self.process = popen(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-loglevel", "error", "-y",
                              "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                              "-video_size", f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", "20",
                              "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", str(path)],
                             stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
        self.closed = False

    def write(self, image):
        if self.closed or len(image.raw_data) != self.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")
        self.process.stdin.write(image.raw_data)

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            self.process.stdin.close()
            if self.process.wait() != 0:
                raise ValueError("Turn source encoder failed")


class TurnCameraCapture:
    def __init__(self, world, carla_module, ego, sinks, *, overview_height_delta_m=0):
        if set(sinks) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("Exactly four named turn source sinks required")
        if overview_height_delta_m not in (0, 2):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported overview camera height change")
        self.sinks = sinks
        self.frames = {name: set() for name in CAMERAS}
        self.condition = Condition()
        self.errors = []
        self.sensors = []
        self.closed = False
        try:
            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():
                if name == 'overview':
                    loc = (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + overview_height_delta_m)
                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", size[0]), ("image_size_y", size[1]),
                                   ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0.05)):
                    blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
                transform = carla_module.Transform(
                    carla_module.Location(*loc), carla_module.Rotation(*rot))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                sensor.listen(lambda image, source=name: self._receive(source, image))
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def _receive(self, name, image):
        with self.condition:
            if self.closed:
                return
            try:
                if image.frame in self.frames[name]:
                    raise ValueError("Duplicate original turn camera frame")
                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:
                    raise ValueError("Original turn camera dimensions changed")
                self.sinks[name].write(image)
                self.frames[name].add(image.frame)
            except BaseException as error:
                self.errors.append(error)
            finally:
                self.condition.notify_all()

    def wait_for_frame(self, frame, *, timeout_s=10):
        deadline = monotonic() + timeout_s
        with self.condition:
            while True:
                if self.errors:
                    raise ValueError("Turn source camera callback failed") from self.errors[0]
                if all(frame in observed for observed in self.frames.values()):
                    return
                remaining = deadline - monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Missing original turn source camera frame")
                self.condition.wait(remaining)

    def verify(self, frames):
        expected = set(frames)
        if not expected or any(observed != expected for observed in self.frames.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

from math import hypot, isfinite


def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two-dimensional point")
    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    length = hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate surveyed line")
    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))
    return hypot(point[0] - a[0] - clamped * forward[0],
                 point[1] - a[1] - clamped * forward[1])


def measure_turn_position(body_corners, *, approach_centerline,
                          destination_left_curb, intersection_entry):
    """Preserve all corner offsets to the approach centerline and left curb.

    Approach segment points toward the intersection. Negative signed lateral
    values are on its right. Destination curb points in the one-way travel
    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.

    ka, kb, kf, klen = _line(destination_left_curb)
    if _distance_to_segment(entry, ca, cb, cf, clen) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")
    return {
        "approach_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) for p in corners],
        "approach_all_corners_right_of_centerline": all(
            _signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) < 0 for p in corners),
        "destination_curb_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ka, kf)
                                                      for p in corners],
        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)
                                                for p in corners],
        "intersection_entry_xy_m": list(entry),
    }

            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")

            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():

                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:

            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

from math import hypot, isfinite


def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two-dimensional point")
    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    length = hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate surveyed line")
    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))
    return hypot(point[0] - a[0] - clamped * forward[0],

    Approach segment points toward the intersection. Negative signed lateral
    values are on its right. Destination curb points in the one-way travel
    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.

    entry = _point(intersection_entry)
    ca, cb, cf, clen = _line(approach_centerline)
    ka, kb, kf, klen = _line(destination_left_curb)
    if _distance_to_segment(entry, ca, cb, cf, clen) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")
    return {
        "approach_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) for p in corners],

        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)

    }

import subprocess

    "approach": ((1.2, 0, 2), (0, 0, 0), (1280, 720), 90),

class LosslessSourceSink:
    def __init__(self, output, name, *, popen=subprocess.Popen):
        if name not in CAMERAS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown turn source camera")
        path = Path(output) / (name + ".mkv")
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Retain prior turn camera source")

                              "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra",
                              "-video_size", f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", "20",
                              "-i", "pipe:0", "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", str(path)],
                             stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
        self.closed = False

    def write(self, image):
        if self.closed or len(image.raw_data) != self.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")
        self.process.stdin.write(image.raw_data)

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            self.process.stdin.close()
            if self.process.wait() != 0:
                raise ValueError("Turn source encoder failed")

                if name == 'overview':

def _point(value):

def _line(segment):

    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]

def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):

def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]

        "approach_all_corners_right_of_centerline": all(

        "destination_curb_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ka, kf)

        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)

            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):

                sensor.destroy()

from math import hypot, isfinite


def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two-dimensional point")
    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    length = hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate surveyed line")
    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))
    return hypot(point[0] - a[0] - clamped * forward[0],
                 point[1] - a[1] - clamped * forward[1])

    """Preserve all corner offsets to the approach centerline and left curb.

    Approach segment points toward the intersection. Negative signed lateral
    values are on its right. Destination curb points in the one-way travel
    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.

        raise ValueError("Need four distinct measured body corners")

    ca, cb, cf, clen = _line(approach_centerline)
    ka, kb, kf, klen = _line(destination_left_curb)
    if _distance_to_segment(entry, ca, cb, cf, clen) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")
    return {
        "approach_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) for p in corners],
        "approach_all_corners_right_of_centerline": all(
            _signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) < 0 for p in corners),
        "destination_curb_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ka, kf)

        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)

                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")

                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:

            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

    if len(value) != 2:

    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]

    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length

    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]

                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", size[0]), ("image_size_y", size[1]),
                                   ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0.05)):

                    carla_module.Location(*loc), carla_module.Rotation(*rot))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                sensor.listen(lambda image, source=name: self._receive(source, image))

    def _receive(self, name, image):

                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:

    def wait_for_frame(self, frame, *, timeout_s=10):
        deadline = monotonic() + timeout_s
        with self.condition:
            while True:
                if self.errors:
                    raise ValueError("Turn source camera callback failed") from self.errors[0]
                if all(frame in observed for observed in self.frames.values()):
                    return
                remaining = deadline - monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Missing original turn source camera frame")
                self.condition.wait(remaining)

    def verify(self, frames):
        expected = set(frames)
        if not expected or any(observed != expected for observed in self.frames.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:

            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two-dimensional point")
    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    length = hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate surveyed line")
    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))
    return hypot(point[0] - a[0] - clamped * forward[0],

    Approach segment points toward the intersection. Negative signed lateral
    values are on its right. Destination curb points in the one-way travel
    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.

    ca, cb, cf, clen = _line(approach_centerline)
    ka, kb, kf, klen = _line(destination_left_curb)
    if _distance_to_segment(entry, ca, cb, cf, clen) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")
    return {
        "approach_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) for p in corners],
        "approach_all_corners_right_of_centerline": all(

        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)

        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)

class LosslessSourceSink:
    def __init__(self, output, name, *, popen=subprocess.Popen):

        if self.closed or len(image.raw_data) != self.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("Original turn camera byte count changed")
        self.process.stdin.write(image.raw_data)

        if not self.closed:

    def __init__(self, world, carla_module, ego, sinks, *, overview_height_delta_m=0):

            raise ValueError("Exactly four named turn source sinks required")
        if overview_height_delta_m not in (0, 2):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported overview camera height change")
        self.sinks = sinks
        self.frames = {name: set() for name in CAMERAS}
        self.condition = Condition()
        self.errors = []
        self.sensors = []
        self.closed = False
        try:
            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():
                if name == 'overview':
                    loc = (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + overview_height_delta_m)
                blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                for key, value in (("image_size_x", size[0]), ("image_size_y", size[1]),
                                   ("fov", fov), ("sensor_tick", 0.05)):
                    blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
                transform = carla_module.Transform(
                    carla_module.Location(*loc), carla_module.Rotation(*rot))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, transform, attach_to=ego)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                sensor.listen(lambda image, source=name: self._receive(source, image))
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def _receive(self, name, image):
        with self.condition:
            if self.closed:
                return
            try:
                if image.frame in self.frames[name]:
                    raise ValueError("Duplicate original turn camera frame")
                if (image.width, image.height) != CAMERAS[name][2]:
                    raise ValueError("Original turn camera dimensions changed")
                self.sinks[name].write(image)
                self.frames[name].add(image.frame)
            except BaseException as error:
                self.errors.append(error)
            finally:
                self.condition.notify_all()

    def wait_for_frame(self, frame, *, timeout_s=10):
        deadline = monotonic() + timeout_s
        with self.condition:
            while True:
                if self.errors:
                    raise ValueError("Turn source camera callback failed") from self.errors[0]
                if all(frame in observed for observed in self.frames.values()):
                    return
                remaining = deadline - monotonic()
                if remaining <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Missing original turn source camera frame")
                self.condition.wait(remaining)

        expected = set(frames)
        if not expected or any(observed != expected for observed in self.frames.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing or extra original turn camera frames")
        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

    def close(self):
        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()

from math import hypot, isfinite


def _point(value):
    if len(value) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected two-dimensional point")
    result = tuple(float(v) for v in value)
    if not all(isfinite(v) for v in result):
        raise ValueError("Nonfinite surveyed geometry")
    return result


def _line(segment):
    if len(segment) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Expected surveyed line segment")
    a, b = (_point(value) for value in segment)
    dx, dy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    length = hypot(dx, dy)
    if length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Degenerate surveyed line")
    return a, b, (dx / length, dy / length), length


def _signed_lateral(point, a, forward):
    return forward[0] * (point[1] - a[1]) - forward[1] * (point[0] - a[0])


def _distance_to_segment(point, a, b, forward, length):
    along = (point[0] - a[0]) * forward[0] + (point[1] - a[1]) * forward[1]
    clamped = max(0, min(length, along))
    return hypot(point[0] - a[0] - clamped * forward[0],
                 point[1] - a[1] - clamped * forward[1])


def measure_turn_position(body_corners, *, approach_centerline,
                          destination_left_curb, intersection_entry):
    """Preserve all corner offsets to the approach centerline and left curb.

    Approach segment points toward the intersection. Negative signed lateral
    values are on its right. Destination curb points in the one-way travel
    direction, so positive signed lateral values lie left of its directed line.
    Callers must source and verify roadway direction and line identity.
    """
    corners = [_point(value) for value in body_corners]
    if len(corners) != 4 or len(set(corners)) != 4:
        raise ValueError("Need four distinct measured body corners")
    entry = _point(intersection_entry)
    ca, cb, cf, clen = _line(approach_centerline)
    ka, kb, kf, klen = _line(destination_left_curb)
    if _distance_to_segment(entry, ca, cb, cf, clen) > 1e-6:
        raise ValueError("Intersection entry is not on surveyed centerline")
    return {
        "approach_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) for p in corners],
        "approach_all_corners_right_of_centerline": all(
            _signed_lateral(p, ca, cf) < 0 for p in corners),
        "destination_curb_signed_corner_offsets_m": [_signed_lateral(p, ka, kf)
                                                      for p in corners],
        "destination_curb_corner_distances_m": [_distance_to_segment(p, ka, kb, kf, klen)
                                                for p in corners],
        "intersection_entry_xy_m": list(entry),
    }

            for name, (loc, rot, size, fov) in CAMERAS.items():
                if name == 'overview':

        return {name: len(expected) for name in CAMERAS}

        if not self.closed:
            self.closed = True
            for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
                sensor.stop()
                sensor.destroy()
